play.definition: A special-teams play in which the defensive field-goal block unit penetrates or elevates through the protection and makes visible contact with the kicked ball at or near the kick point, altering its normal trajectory and potentially creating a dead-ball result, loose-ball recovery, or return opportunity.

action.label: Block Kick
action.definition: A special-teams defender's successful contact with a kicked football that prevents or significantly alters a field-goal attempt, extra-point attempt, kickoff, or other kick.

action.label: Kick Ball
action.definition: A kicker's action of striking the football with the foot to initiate a kickoff, field-goal attempt, extra-point attempt, free kick, or other legal kicking play.

action.label: None
action.definition: A temporal label used when the player is visible but is not performing any defined football action in the action taxonomy during the annotated interval.

action.label: Place Ball
action.definition: A holder's action of receiving the snap and positioning the football on the ground for a field-goal or extra-point attempt.

action.label: Pre Snap
action.definition: The period before the snap when players are set in formation and no active play has begun.
